title: The Between-Round Decision in Autonomous Research: An LLM Controller That Reads the Whole Trajectory
abstract: arXiv:2611.22661v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Executing an idea often changes how promising it looks, so the next step in autonomous research should rest on results, not on proposals. After each round of experiments, the system must decide whether to refine the best solution or start a new direction, which solution to build from, and what goal to set. We call this the between-round decision. Existing systems wrap it in machinery such as rules, scores, search trees, and schedules; where an LLM makes it, what the LLM needs to read is left open. We ask whether an LLM can make this decision from accumulated evidence, without a search structure around it, and how much of that evidence it needs to read. We present BRED (Between-Round Evidence-based Decision), an LLM-based controller that maintains the best verified solution so far (the Champion) and a log of past rounds, and makes one decision per round. translated_title: 自主研究中的轮间决策：一个读取完整轨迹的LLM控制器
translated_abstract: 执行一个想法往往会改变它看起来有多有前景，因此自主研究的下一步应该基于结果而非提案。在每轮实验之后，系统必须决定是继续改进最佳解决方案还是开启新方向、以哪个解决方案为基础进行构建、以及设定什么目标。我们将此称为“轮间决策”。现有系统用规则、评分、搜索树和调度等机制来处理这一决策；而在由LLM做出该决策的场合，LLM需要读取哪些内容仍是一个悬而未决的问题。我们探究LLM能否在没有周围搜索结构辅助的情况下，仅凭积累的证据做出这一决策，以及它需要读取多少证据。我们提出了BRED（Between-Round Evidence-based Decision，基于证据的轮间决策），这是一个基于LLM的控制器，它维护迄今为止最佳的已验证解决方案（称为Champion）以及过往轮次的日志，并在每轮做出一次决策。在三个广泛使用的研究智能体基准任务上，BRED优于任务基线（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出BRED，一个基于LLM的轮间决策控制器，通过维护最佳已验证解决方案（Champion）和过往轮次日志，让LLM直接读取完整轨迹证据来决定是改进现有方案还是开辟新方向，从而摆脱了规则、评分和搜索树等外部机制。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces BRED, an LLM-based controller for the between-round decision in autonomous research that reads the whole accumulated trajectory—maintaining the best verified Champion solution and a log of past rounds—so the LLM itself decides whether to refine the best solution or start a new direction, without any surrounding search structure.
